

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Metal Rat|kanji=庚子|romaji=kanoe nezumi|onyomi=kōshi|p=gēngzǐ|w=keng-tzŭ|mi=kɤŋ⁵³ tsɨ|y=geng1 zi2|j=geng1 zi2|ci=kɪŋ tsi|mc=kæŋ tsi|oc-bs=kˤraŋ tsi}}
{{Otheruses|Sexagenary cycle|西涼の元号|庚子 (西涼)}}

{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Metal Rat''' (庚子, ''kanoe nezumi''; onyomi ''kōshi'') is the 37th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 37th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Pig|af|Aardvark (astrologie)|cdo|Gī-hâi|de|Erde-Schwein|fr|Cochon de terre (Cycle sexagésimal chinois)|hak|Kí-hoi|ja|己亥|ko|기해|nds|Eer-Swien|vi|Kỷ Hợi|za|Geijhaih|zh|己亥|zh_min_nan|Kí-hāi|zh_yue|己亥|qid=Q904335}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Ox|af|Metaalos (astrologie)|cdo|Sĭng-tiū|de|Metall-Büffel|hak|Sîn-chhiú|ja|辛丑|ko|신축|vi|Tân Sửu|za|Sincouj|zh|辛丑|zh_min_nan|Sin-thiú|zh_yue|辛丑|qid=Q904956}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''子'' (Rat) is Yang Water; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Rat (庚子)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngzǐ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 zi2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoe-nezumi
*** On'yomi: kōshi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongja (경자)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Tý

==Months of Yang Metal Rat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)}} and {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)}}), the month of {{ill|November|en|November|qid=Q125|lt=November}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Metal Rat|ja|庚子}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Lesser Cold}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Metal Rat==
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Yang Metal Rat|ja|庚子}} is the 8th day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten Ten Ichijō|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
